grant-eozobservations: Submit attributed gameplay observations (does not edit pages)
apihelp-eozobservations-summary: Store attributed, data-only kill and loot observations. Article creation and editing use the standard edit API. See API Documentation.
apihelp-eozobservations-param-operation: Check authenticated capability or submit an idempotent observation batch.
apihelp-eozobservations-param-batch: JSON schemaVersion 1 batch; at most 100 events and 262144 UTF-8 bytes. See API_Documentation.
apihelp-eqlmetadata-summary: Read batched revision-aware EQL era metadata. See API Documentation for page, image and contribution workflows.
apihelp-eqlmetadata-param-titles: Pipe-separated wiki titles; at most the configured title limit (normally 500).
apierror-eoz-login: Log in with a named wiki account before sending observations.
apierror-eoz-blocked: This wiki account cannot send observations while blocked.
apierror-eoz-email: Confirm your wiki email before sending observations.
apierror-eoz-disabled: This wiki is not accepting Eye of Zomm observations.
apierror-eoz-schema: Eye of Zomm observation storage has not been activated.
apierror-eoz-schema-unavailable: Eye of Zomm observation storage has not been activated.
apierror-eoz-invalid: The observation batch contains unsupported or invalid data.
apierror-eoz-rate-limit: The observation upload limit was reached. Keep the local batch and retry later.
apierror-eoz-capacity: Observation storage is full. Keep pending data locally until the wiki operator resolves capacity.
apierror-eoz-batch-conflict: This observation batch ID already belongs to different content. Review the pending batch.
